## Invitations

A total of 1834 people were invited. Of these, 1095 attended, representing an attendance rate of 59.7 per cent. The figures provide a clear summary of participation during the reporting period and indicate the proportion of invitees who took part. Attendance information is recorded alongside the invitation total to support straightforward review of outreach activity.

The invitation and attendance figures should be considered together when assessing the reach of the service. They provide the basis for understanding how many people were contacted and how many subsequently attended.

## Contact

SMS messages were sent to 1551 invitees. A further 1424 reminders were issued to support contact and encourage attendance. These communication measures formed part of the outreach approach and are recorded separately from the attendance figures.

Van days were maintained where road conditions allowed. This supported the continuation of outreach activity where access was feasible. The contact figures and operational note are included to provide a concise account of the arrangements used.

Prepared by G. Evans.
